description: Release-blocking requirements for real-artifact upgrade E2E. Each requirement must either have a runnable driver (entry script exists and was executed with a passing result) or an explicit, dated waiver. Expired waivers FAIL the release — there is no permanently-green placeholder path.

requirements.summary: Install previous stable .app, seed user data, upgrade with the candidate .app.tar.gz, verify migrations + data integrity.

driver.notes: No macOS WKWebView WebDriver support upstream; driver must orchestrate app launch + data-dir assertions directly (tauri-driver does not support macOS).

waiver.reason: No macOS upgrade-E2E driver exists in the repository yet. This waiver is temporary and visible in every release's compatibility report; when it expires, releases fail until a driver lands or the waiver is consciously renewed in review.

requirements.summary: Install previous stable setup.exe, seed user data, upgrade with the candidate setup.exe, verify migrations + data integrity.

driver.notes: Reuse the tauri-driver + msedgedriver path from .github/workflows/webdriver.yml once e2e-tests/ exists.

waiver.reason: webdriver.yml is disabled because e2e-tests/ does not exist; no Windows upgrade-E2E driver yet.

requirements.summary: Unpack previous stable AppImage, seed user data, upgrade with the candidate AppImage, verify migrations + data integrity.

driver.notes: Reuse the tauri-driver + webkit2gtk-driver + xvfb path from .github/workflows/webdriver.yml once e2e-tests/ exists.

waiver.reason: webdriver.yml is disabled because e2e-tests/ does not exist; no Linux upgrade-E2E driver yet.

requirements.summary: Install previous stable APK on an emulator, seed user data, upgrade-install the candidate APK, verify migrations + data integrity.

driver.notes: Requires reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner (or equivalent) plus adb-driven data seeding/assertions.

waiver.reason: No Android emulator upgrade-E2E driver exists in the repository yet.
